name: Carbon network of rings, alkynes and sp2 nodes
description: Benzene rings (C6, linked 1,3,5), acetylene linkers (C2) and trigonal sp2 carbon nodes (one carbon, linked three ways), each able to join itself and the others: ring-ring (biaryl), ring-alkyne, alkyne-alkyne (polyyne: a single bond, 1.369 A), node-node (graphitic, 1.398 A), and node to ring or alkyne. Alkynes are typed cg#ch (GAFF's conjugated sp carbons), and an alkyne joins another only like end to like end, so every alkyne-alkyne link is the single bond. GAFF 1.81 parameters (params/gaff_carbon), a rigid-body optimisation with dihedrals after each pass; then a closing phase: three rounds of a wide zip (3.0 A, 110 degrees, clash-checked) and an all-atom (flexible) optimisation, which closes rings, including across the periodic boundary so the framework spans the cell, and lets the blocks flex (docs/closing.md); then Poreblazer. See docs/carbon-linkers.md.
